sync.blocked_lease_unreadable: Not syncing — ohmail cannot read its own folder on that server. It keeps trying.
sync.blocked_awaiting_credentials: Not syncing — no mailbox password is stored for this mailbox.
sync.blocked_at_capacity: Not syncing — ohmail did not pick this mailbox up. This one is on us.
sync.blocked_read_limited: ohmail read what it could; this mailbox's server sent more than one pass can take. It will try again.
sync.blocked_clock_off: Not syncing — this computer's clock is too far from the mail server's for ohmail to organize this mailbox safely. Set the clock; ohmail starts again on its own.
sync.blocked_account_closed: Not syncing — this account's subscription has ended. Your mailbox is untouched, and syncing starts again once the account is active.
sync.notice_provider_unavailable: The mail server asked ohmail to wait.
sync.blocked_provider_unavailable: Not syncing for now — the mail server asked ohmail to wait. It tries again on its own.
sync.blocked_meta_folder_full: Not syncing — the ohmail/_meta folder on that server holds more messages than ohmail can read. Move mail that was filed into it to another folder and leave the messages ohmail wrote (their subject starts with "ohmail"). ohmail starts again on its own.
sync.blocked_meta_undeletable: Not syncing — the mail server will not let ohmail remove its own messages from ohmail/_meta. Give that folder delete permission, or ask your provider. ohmail starts again on its own.
sync.blocked_mailbox_full: Not syncing — your mailbox on that mail server is full, and ohmail needs a little room there to organize it. Free up space in your provider's webmail or another mail app; ohmail starts again on its own.
sync.blocked_organized_elsewhere_local: Not organized here — ohmail on your own machine has claimed this mailbox. Your mail still arrives and is readable and searchable here; nothing is filed from here. Settings → Mailboxes has the control that moves the organizing to this install, and the other one then reads the mailbox.
sync.blocked_organized_elsewhere_cloud: Not organized here — another ohmail Cloud install has claimed this mailbox. Your mail still arrives and is readable and searchable here; nothing is filed from here. Settings → Mailboxes has the control that moves the organizing to this install, and the other one then reads the mailbox.
sync.blockedClaimedByServer: Not organized here — another ohmail server has claimed this mailbox. Your mail still arrives and is readable and searchable here; nothing is filed from here. Settings → Mailboxes has the control that moves the organizing to this install, and the other one then reads the mailbox.
sync.blocked_organized_elsewhere_mobile: Not organized here — a phone has claimed this mailbox, and a phone organizes only while ohmail is open on it. Your mail still arrives and is readable and searchable here; nothing is filed from here. Settings → Mailboxes has the control that moves the organizing to this install, and the phone then reads the mailbox.
sync.blocked_organized_elsewhere_unknown: Not organized here — another ohmail organizer has claimed this mailbox. Your mail still arrives and is readable and searchable here; nothing is filed from here. Settings → Mailboxes has the control that moves the organizing to this install, and the other one then reads the mailbox.
